errors.text_span: Етикетите са разположени на интервали от една година.
errors.evidence: The labels on the x-axis are at 2010, 2012, 2014, 2016, 2018, 2020, and 2021. The interval is mostly two years, not one year.
The final value for 2021 is clearly above 6 million, at approximately 6.8 million.

errors.text_span: растеж от около 5.9 милиона регистрации за посочения период.
errors.evidence: This calculated growth is based on the incorrect end value of 6 million. The actual growth shown is approximately 6.7 million (from ~0.1M to ~6.8M).

errors.text_span: Линията показва постепенно увеличение от 2010 г. до 2021 г.
errors.evidence: The description of the trend as a "gradual increase" is an over-generalization. A key visual feature of the chart is the significant acceleration of the increase in later years, which this description misses.
The description omits the label for the data series provided in the legend, which is "Регистрации".
